blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: Big O describes the upper bound on how work grows with input size, not the precise milliseconds of an execution.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: A fixed direct index operation is O(1), scanning n values is O(n), and repeatedly halving n is O(log n).

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: For n=64, a linear scan may inspect 64 items, while halving 64→1 takes six halvings. Sorting requirements and constants still matter.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain
blocks.text: The number of operations doubles when n doubles.
